title: A New Approach to the Economic Analysis of Nonstationary Time Series and the Business Cycle
key_point: Markov-switching model: parameters jump between a few hidden states with persistent transition probabilities

title: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
key_point: Online (past-data-only) probability that a change happened recently; usable without look-ahead

title: Selection of estimation window in the presence of breaks
key_point: Pre-break data can still help forecasts (bias vs variance); pick or pool windows by out-of-sample error

title: Optimal detection of changepoints with a linear computational cost (PELT)
key_point: Offline multi-change-point segmentation; uses the whole sample so it is descriptive unless rerun on past data only

title: Out-of-sample forecast tests robust to the choice of window size
key_point: Trying many windows and reporting the best is data snooping; report results across all windows

title: Optimal forecasts in the presence of structural breaks
key_point: Optimal weights ~ exponential down-weighting under gradual change; regime-level weights under discrete breaks; robust weights when break dates uncertain

title: Rolling window selection for out-of-sample forecasting with time-varying parameters
key_point: Window length chosen by minimizing forecast loss; improves on conventional choices

title: Contrarian Factor Timing Is Deceptively Difficult
key_point: Timing overlays that look good alone often add little after costs and diversification

title: Learning hidden Markov models with persistent states by penalizing jumps
key_point: Plain HMMs switch state too often when misspecified; jump penalty enforces persistent regimes

title: Principles and algorithms for forecasting groups of time series: Locality and globality
key_point: One pooled (global) model across many series generalizes as well or better than per-series models even when series differ

title: Hedging demand and market intraday momentum
key_point: Intraday momentum in 60+ futures 1974-2020 pooled; linked to option-dealer gamma hedging (stronger on negative-gamma days)

title: Downside risk reduction using regime-switching signals: a statistical jump model approach
key_point: Jump-model regimes from return-only features; out-of-sample 1990-2023 US/DE/JP with costs and delay; lower drawdown/vol and better Sharpe than HMM and buy-and-hold; penalty set by time-series CV

title: Identifying patterns in financial markets: extending the statistical jump model for regime identification
key_point: Continuous (probabilistic) jump model; more robust; helps most when regimes are imbalanced and history short

authors: Mulliner Harvey Xia Fang & van Hemert
title: Regimes
peer_reviewed: yes (practitioner journal; authors at Man Group)
key_point: Monthly similarity to every past month on 7 macro/market variables (annual change z-scored vs rolling 10y; capped +-3; summed squared distance); similar-quintile vs dissimilar-quintile factor timing Sharpe 0.82 gross 1985-2024; weak when no precedent (COVID)

authors: Kanas (2003 J Forecasting); Panagiotidis (2010 Comput Econ)
title: Nearest-neighbour (analog) forecasts of stock returns
key_point: Analog/kNN return forecasts did not beat simple benchmarks out of sample
